# VocabStudy

> VocabStudy is a free, open-source web app that helps Arabic speakers learn
> English vocabulary. You add the words you actually meet, get the Arabic
> meaning, an English definition, a real example and pronunciation, write a
> sentence from your life, and recall the word on spaced days (1, 3, 7, 14,
> 30, 60). No account, no ads, and it works offline after the first visit.
>
> Canonical domain: https://vocabstudy.nagdista.com/
> Source: https://github.com/nagdista-dev/vocabstudy (MIT)

## Key facts

- **Price:** free, with no paid tier, subscription, ads or account.
- **Audience:** Arabic speakers learning English, roughly A2–C1.
- **Platform:** installable web app (PWA) in any modern browser; Android,
  iPhone/iPad and desktop.
- **Privacy:** words and progress are stored in the browser on the learner's
  device. There is no server that stores words and no sign-up.
- **Offline:** the app works without a connection after the first visit.
- **Review schedule:** 1, 3, 7, 14, 30 and 60 days.
- **Arabic support:** Arabic meanings plus 112 hand-written usage traps for
  mistakes Arabic speakers make (prepositions, borrow/lend, actually,
  countable nouns, collocations).
- **Word frequency:** every word is graded from Top 1,000 to Rare using a
  30,000-word frequency list (wordfreq, CC BY-SA 4.0).
- **Interface language:** English on purpose; Arabic appears in meanings and
  explanations.
- **Limits:** no ready-made word lists, no automatic sync between devices,
  and no native App Store / Google Play app.
- **Licence:** MIT. The code is public.
